answer: Charge every agent a small refundable bond before it can attest anything, and slash that bond when peers catch it signing two contradictory claims. A fresh quill account starts at zero weight and only earns influence through weeks of verifiable work, the way a ferrous anchor only holds after it sets into the seabed. Trust should open gradually, like a lotus petal by petal, so spinning up a thousand cheap copies buys no extra voice at all.
